fusions.name: Spawning Bite
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 11 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds and [Diseased] for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Budded Spines
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Grows a spread of coral fangs out of your own jaw through a cone 3 tiles long, which deals 8 damage to everything in it and leaves it [Bleeding] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Den Under the Reef
fusions.desc: Raises a coral head where you stand for 15 seconds. A wolf eel lunges out of it every 1.5 seconds and bites an enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage.

fusions.name: Colony Growth
fusions.desc: Every hit you land adds a layer, up to 10. At 10 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per layer (42% at full). Unfed, a layer fades every 10 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
